conflicts.resolvedFinding: Core authorised CASP service types have a strong legal basis and Poland-facing service evidence, but actual product availability remains country/product specific; use AVAILABLE_WITH_LIMITS, not blanket available.

conflicts.topic: PLN deposit/trading vs exact PLN withdrawal
conflicts.resolvedFinding: PLN deposit via BLIK and PLN trading pairs are supported; exact PLN withdrawal remains unverified.
Earn exists but is separately described as unregulated under MiCAR and remains product/jurisdiction gated.

conflicts.topic: Poland offers/referral surfaces vs current CBW referral binding
conflicts.resolvedFinding: Poland offers/referral campaigns are real, but CBW global Bybit URL/code is not bound to current Bybit EU Poland eligibility by this evidence.
